dialogue.text: [warm, storytelling] Level three is five thousand dollars. The next customer is a nurse with the same kind of account, but he keeps five thousand dollars in it and his paycheck lands here every two weeks, so he never pays that twelve-dollar fee.
I got three credit card offers this week. From you guys.

[warm, storytelling] And they do, but what they really like is his paycheck. The bank pays him almost nothing to hold it, then lends that same money out as car loans and mortgages and keeps the interest. And that paycheck shows up every two weeks, like clockwork.
So what's he to the bank?
[warm, storytelling] Jess still doesn't know who's paying for all of this, but the next customer is about to show her who isn't.
